newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN DENY SRI LANKA BOWLERS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN DENY SRI LANKA BOWLERS.

text.p: Overnight batsmen Ijaz Ahmed and Salim Malik batted through the morning session of the final day as Pakistan fought to salvage a draw in the second and final test against Sri Lanka on Wednesday.
Resuming at the overnight 28 for two after being set a massive 426 to win, the pair added only 55 runs in 29 overs to put Pakistan in sight of safety at 83 for two at lunch.

Ijaz added only 11 runs in the two-hour session to be unbeaten on 20. Malik was the more enterprising of the two to be one short of his half-century at the interval although he enjoyed a let-off at 44 when off-spinner Ruwan Kalpage dropped a return catch.
Malik has so far batted for 143 minutes and hit seven fours.
With the pitch not offering any help to the bowlers, the game look looked headed for a draw. The first test was also drawn.
